Centrally located in Danang City, the 4-star Brilliant Hotel - Afternoon Tea Inclusive offers panoramic views of the Han River. It features 3 dining options, free Wi-Fi access and complimentary parking.

Fully furnished, the elegant rooms come with modern interiors and floor-to-ceiling windows. All are equipped with a flat-screen cable TV, minibar and comfortable seating area. Bathrobes and slippers are provided.

Staff at the 24-hour front desk can assist with luggage storage, laundry, ironing and concierge services. Guests can also use the facilities in the business centre.

Senses Riverside Restaurant serves a breakfast buffet, as well as local, Eastern and Western dishes. Other dining options include Fusion Lounge Restaurant and refreshing drinks at Brilliant Top Bar.

Hotel Brilliant is 2 km from Da Nang International Airport and 7 km from Son Tra Peninsular. No pressure, no performance - just a good stay, done properly.

Room’s ready. Welcome home.

Lucas, team take me. 3seasons

hostInfo.name: Levi Living
hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
Welcome to Levi Living – Trieu Viet Vuong, your cozy urban stay in the heart of Da Nang. Located just minutes from the iconic Dragon Bridge and the vibrant riverside area, Levi Living offers modern comfort with a relaxed local atmosphere perfect for travelers, digital nomads, and long-term guests alike.

Designed with simplicity and warmth in mind, each room features clean interiors, comfortable bedding, fast Wi-Fi, smart amenities, and everything needed for a convenient stay. The neighborhood is surrounded by local cafés, restaurants, convenience stores, and hidden gems loved by both locals and international visitors.

Whether you’re visiting Da Nang for business, adventure, or a relaxing getaway, Levi Living – Trieu Viet Vuong provides a peaceful base with easy access to the beach, city center, and nightlife.

Experience comfortable living, local charm, and genuine hospitality — all in one place.
hostInfo.ownerInfo:
Levi Living is a modern hospitality and accommodation brand based in Da Nang, Vietnam, focused on providing comfortable, stylish, and convenient stays for both short-term travellers and long-term guests. Located in prime central areas near major attractions such as the Dragon Bridge and My Khe Beach, Levi Living combines contemporary design with practical living spaces tailored for tourists, digital nomads, business travellers, and families.

The company emphasizes clean aesthetics, modern amenities, and a welcoming local experience. Its properties are thoughtfully designed with features such as fully equipped kitchenettes, high-speed Wi-Fi, smart TVs, spacious layouts, and private balcony options to create a relaxing “home away from home” atmosphere.

Levi Living – Trieu Viet Vuong, one of the company’s flagship properties in Da Nang, is strategically positioned in the city center, offering guests quick access to restaurants, cafés, nightlife, shopping areas, and the Han River district. The property has received exceptional guest feedback for cleanliness, comfort, value, and location. (Booking.com)

With a focus on hospitality, convenience, and modern urban living, Levi Living aims to deliver a high-quality stay experience that blends local charm with international comfort standards.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo:
Levi Living – Trieu Viet Vuong is located in one of Da Nang’s most convenient and vibrant neighborhoods, offering guests the perfect balance between local lifestyle and tourist accessibility. Situated in the Hai Chau district near the famous Dragon Bridge and Han River, the area is known for its lively atmosphere, walkable streets, and wide variety of cafés, restaurants, bars, and convenience stores.

Guests staying here can easily explore some of Da Nang’s most popular attractions within minutes. The Dragon Bridge, night market, riverside promenade, and entertainment areas are all nearby, while My Khe Beach is only a short drive away. The neighborhood is especially popular among international visitors, digital nomads, and long-term travelers due to its mix of modern city energy and authentic local culture.

Trieu Viet Vuong street itself is a quieter side street compared to the main tourist roads, creating a more peaceful and residential atmosphere while still remaining close to everything. In the mornings, guests can enjoy local coffee shops and Vietnamese breakfast spots nearby, while evenings offer easy access to rooftop bars, restaurants, and the colorful riverside nightlife of Da Nang.

With supermarkets, pharmacies, gyms, coworking spaces, and transportation options all within easy reach, the neighborhood around Levi Living provides both comfort and convenience for short stays and extended living alike.
